title: Effects of Sn doping content on the structure, morphology, optical and electrical properties of ITO thin films prepared by microwave-assisted spray pyrolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7538-7548
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09041E, Paper
Open Access

Yulun Feng, Leyuan Zhang, Haoran Chen, Lihua Zhang, Xin Guo, Xinya Liu, Shenghui Guo
Indium tin oxide (ITO) thin films with 0–20 wt% SnO2 were prepared via microwave-assisted spray pyrolysis. The 10 wt% SnO2-doped film shows optimal optoelectronic performance, suitable for transparent conductive electrodes.
